description: This file defines a serializer codec for well-known StringComparer types in the Orleans.Serialization framework, including methods to support serialization and deserialization of StringComparer instances and related equality/culture info objects.

classes.name: WellKnownStringComparerCodec
classes.description: Serializer for well-known StringComparer types, supporting serialization and deserialization based on comparer type and culture info.

classes.name: EqualityComparerBaseCodec
classes.description: Serializer and copier for EqualityComparer<T> instances.

classes.name: ComparerBaseCodec
classes.description: Serializer and copier for Comparer<T> instances.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a given type is supported for serialization in this codec.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a StringComparer instance from the wire format.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a StringComparer or related object to the wire format.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy; implementation is empty indicating immutability.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Completes deserialization; implementation is a no-op for immutable types.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the comparer or equality object; implementation is a no-op for stateless or immutable objects.
